_comment: Global policy for the gas-reimbursement workflow. Edit values here; no code change needed.
_pay_basis_note: 'matrix' = reimburse on Matrix road miles (authoritative). Odometer is cross-check only.
_variance_note: If |claimed odometer miles - matrix miles| / matrix miles exceeds this %, the leg becomes a VARIANCE exception.
_fuzzy_cutoff_note: Minimum name/address similarity (0-1) to accept an automatic match.
_fuzzy_margin_note: Top candidate must beat the 2nd candidate by at least this much, else AMBIGUOUS.
_home_leg_note: Home/apartment legs are ALWAYS flagged for HR/manual review. Never auto-approved or auto-rejected.
_multistop_note: Rows with multiple destinations are ALWAYS flagged for manual itemization. Route order is never guessed.
